gap.title: Search: a level space of 4 x 5 matrices of dimension at least 8 (would refute the bound p + q - 2 at four rows)
gap.statement: ∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 5 → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, (∑ i : Fin 4, ∑ j, t (i, j)) = 0 ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, if j = l then 0 else ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ b : Fin 4, if a < b then t (a, j) * t (b, l) else 0) = 0 ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, ∑ m, if j = l ∨ j = m ∨ l = m then 0 else ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ b : Fin 4, ∑ c : Fin 4, if a < b ∧ b < c then t (a, j) * t (b, l) * t (c, m) else 0) = 0 ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, ∑ m, ∑ n, if j = l ∨ j = m ∨ j = n ∨ l = m ∨ l = n ∨ m = n then 0 else t (0, j) * t (1, l) * t (2, m) * t (3, n)) = 0) ∧ 8 ≤ Module.finrank ℂ L
gap.unlocks: Needed by seat-barrier-1 for: the four-row test of the bound rows plus columns minus 2; a witness refutes it
gap.context: SEARCH GAP, possibly empty: the witness is an explicit object, cheap to check. The idea and what is known are in the plain sentence on the row. A proof must prove exactly the recorded statement, with no sorry, no new axiom and no native_decide.
